description: This file defines the ListViewDataEmails class, which extends ListViewData to provide data handling, querying, and filtering functionality for email list views within the SuiteCRM application. It manages interactions with inbound email sources (CRM and IMAP), processes email headers and fields, and constructs database queries for displaying email data in the UI.

classes.name: ListViewDataEmails
classes.description: A class extending ListViewData to handle email-specific data retrieval, filtering, and query construction for email list views in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: getInboundEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the InboundEmail bean based on user preferences and folder, validating the ID.

methods.name: getSearchType
methods.description: Determines whether the search should be conducted via CRM database or IMAP, based on folder type.

methods.name: setInboundEmailMailbox
methods.description: Sets the mailbox for the InboundEmail object based on folder type.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Constructs filter criteria for email search, switching to CRM or IMAP search based on field types.

methods.name: fixFieldsInFilter
methods.description: Adjusts filter fields and SQL where clause to correctly match database fields and email text fields.

methods.name: getCrmQueryArray
methods.description: Creates a CRM-specific SQL query array for fetching email data.

methods.name: getCrmEmailsQuery
methods.description: Builds the final CRM email query string with custom parameters.

methods.name: getEmailHeaderStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of an email (replied, draft, read, unread) based on header flags.

methods.name: getEmailRecordFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific field values from email headers or associated objects, handling special cases like dates and attachments.

methods.name: getEmailRecord
methods.description: Assembles an email record array with all fields for a particular email header, folder, and inbound email context.

methods.name: isRequestedSearchAdvanced
methods.description: Checks if the current search request is an advanced search.

methods.name: isRequestedSearchBasic
methods.description: Checks if the current search request is a basic search.

methods.name: getEmailUIds
methods.description: Extracts email UIDs from a dataset of email rows.

methods.name: getListViewData
methods.description: Main method to retrieve list view data for emails, orchestrating folder loading, inbound email retrieval, filtering, and executing the appropriate search (CRM or IMAP).

methods.name: callGenerateQueries
methods.description: Wraps the generateQueries method to produce SQL queries based on sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: callGenerateURLS
methods.description: Wraps the generateURLS method to produce URLs for pagination and sorting.
